details: Despite June's Consumer Price Index (CPI) data coming in cooler than expected, several Federal Reserve officials, including Chair Kevin Warsh, have continued to stress the need for vigilance against persistent inflation. Financial markets are largely pricing in an 85% probability that the Fed will maintain current interest rates at its upcoming July Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting. However, a 15% chance of a 25-basis-point rate hike persists due to some hawkish rhetoric, although the overall sentiment is that a rate pause is likely, which is generally supportive of risk assets like Bitcoin.
title: Fed Officials Temper Inflation Enthusiasm, Market Bets on Rate Pause

details: Bitcoin is currently holding above the psychologically significant $64,000 level, a crucial indicator for investors and traders. This stability comes as institutional interest in cryptocurrency Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) shows signs of renewed inflows, reversing a previous period of outflows. The market is increasingly influenced by institutional capital and the dynamics of ETFs, with Ethereum also showing stronger weekly performance than Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Holds Key Level Amid Renewed ETF Inflows

details: US regulators have failed to meet the one-year deadline for finalizing stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act, contributing to ongoing regulatory uncertainty in the digital asset space. Simultaneously, field hearings are being conducted on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act (H.R. 3633) in New York. These hearings aim to establish clear jurisdictional lines, primarily between the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), regarding the oversight of various digital assets.
title: US Regulators Miss Stablecoin Deadline; CLARITY Act Hearings Ongoing

details: The global cryptocurrency market is experiencing significant volatility driven by persistent macroeconomic uncertainty and escalating geopolitical tensions, particularly those involving US-Israel tensions with Iran impacting energy prices. This environment has led to a noticeable shift of capital away from higher-risk assets, a trend also observed in traditional financial markets. Over $328 million in crypto market liquidations have occurred in the past 24 hours, highlighting the vulnerability of leveraged positions during periods of sharp price fluctuations.
title: Macroeconomic Uncertainty & Geopolitical Tensions Fuel Crypto Volatility
